READY FOR AUDIT (operator 116) — growth-project-mobile#344 @ f629e0f9c0ca4fdda5985dad5a775efa80f47a22

Piece P3 of the payment sheet split of #334 (3 pieces: #342 -> #343 -> #344). Base `agent115/sheet-split-2-purchase-hook-sheet`. T4 (max-tier rule).
Checks at this head (latest run per check, 1 checks): all green. CodeQL, danger, banned casts and build-sbom run only when the stack lands on main.
Land rule: Land as one (rule 11) after backend recurring #678-#680 is deployed (OR-112-13 pair with #654).

SIZE ASSESSMENT (operator 116, MODEL_ROUTING 8.2) — growth-project-mobile#344 @ f629e0f9c0ca4fdda5985dad5a775efa80f47a22
- Lines: 2079 changed (source 694 / tests 1385 / migrations 0 / docs 0; excluded 0); 8 files. Under the 3,000 hard limit.
- Seams (largest areas): `src/components/__tests__` 1143, `src/screens/client` 435, `src/components/purchase` 259, `src/__tests__/ClientPackagesScreen.purchase.test.tsx` 157, `src/__tests__/PackageCheckoutScreen.buyer.test.tsx` 85.
- Coupling: code piece with its own tests; the piece boundaries, dependency direction (no piece imports a later piece) and per-piece tests are stated in the PR body.
- Decision: KEEP. This is already one logical piece of the owner-ordered split of #334. Cutting it further would separate code from the tests that prove it, and would add a restack round to every later piece without making any line easier to audit. Fix rounds must keep it under 3,000.

FIX ROUND 1 (restack) (B-SHEET-118, agent 118) — growth-project-mobile#344 @ e7fcc5d2504e8c3948494ee847e16ff4937b78c3

Tier T4 (payments). Restack onto #343 FIX ROUND 1 (`fd739d58`, issuecomment-5982491752): merge commit, no conflicts, plus ONE test-only commit, so this round is not strictly merge-only.

- Merge `d9e7da55`: #343 head `fd739d58` merged into this branch (no conflicts, no S3 source change).
- Test-only commit `e7fcc5d2`: `PackageSelectionSheet.recur3.test.tsx` (TRIAL_PLAN) and `PackageSelectionSheet.subscription.test.tsx` (setup-mode trial) pinned `trial_ends_at` to the fixed instant 2026-10-10T12:00Z. #343 B-343-4 now reviews a resumed trial whose pinned first-charge date differs from the date the sheet shows (today + 7), so those fixtures matched only on one calendar day and then cascaded into later cases through unconsumed mocks. The fixtures now follow today + 7, and the subscription case asserts the formatted date of that instant. No source file of this PR changed.

Size: +1,839 / -247 = 2,086 changed lines against #343 (tests included), inside the 1,500-3,000 band. Stated per the size rule.

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| Restack onto #343 FIX ROUND 1 | merge | d9e7da55 | all S3 suites |
| S3 trial fixtures fixed to one calendar day (follows B-343-4) | today + 7 | e7fcc5d2 | recur3, subscription (local: 4 suites, 61 of 61 pass; before the fixture fix 4 failed) |

## Prior probes replayed
No lens has audited this piece yet (only the operator READY), so there is no #344 probe of its own. The #343 probes of both lenses (Opus probe343, Sol purchaseBoundary, paymentTheme, recur3 B-343-4) and these S3 suites were run against the S2 head with `tsc --noEmit`: https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37219714087 (120 of 120 pass); the same probe files pass on this head locally (30 of 30).

Open gates (not changed here): C-334-2 (native UpdateCard in ClientPackagesScreen) stays an operator / P3 decision. Operator decision: accept the test-only fixture commit as part of the restack (recommended), details in ops/reports/B-SHEET-118.md.

Independent T4 lens: AUD-SOL-SH3-118, agent 118; first #344 piece verdict, not a merge-only attestation. ([PR scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/344), [restack round](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/344#issuecomment-5982498620))

## Prior findings and evidence reuse first

#344 had no prior lens verdict; its thread contains operator READY/SIZE ASSESSMENT KEEP and the builder's restack round. ([Prior thread state](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/344#issuecomment-5975774231), [builder round](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/344#issuecomment-5982498620))

G09 evidence reuse: all four P3 runtime files are byte-identical to the original Sol-approved `78ba9bc9a172f79fec5e7f8c3b0166acbf41dfe1`, verified by an empty exact-file diff against this head; that evidence covers unchanged native-flow wiring, but is not automatic approval of the split or its recovery boundaries. ([Original Sol approval](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5972086092), [candidate files](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/344/files)) All eight piece files and their boundary/call sites were read; the four P3 candidate suites were independently re-executed. ([Independent CI lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220986621))

Original B-334-3/4 remain closed for their original uncertainty/consent counterexamples, and C-334-3's original held-successful-read unmount case passes; lower-piece findings remain the lower pieces' responsibility, not new blockers assigned to #344. ([Original disposition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5972086092), [re-executed recur3 suite](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220986621)) The original C-334-2 card-update composition gate remains carried below. ([Original disposition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5972086092))

The accepted test-only trial fixture delta is reasonable: matching-date fixtures now follow today + 7, preserve setup-mode/card-secret/first-charge-date assertions, and both trial suites pass; no runtime P3 file changed in the restack. ([Exact fixture commit](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/commit/e7fcc5d2504e8c3948494ee847e16ff4937b78c3), [trial test](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e7fcc5d2504e8c3948494ee847e16ff4937b78c3/src/components/__tests__/PackageSelectionSheet.subscription.test.tsx#L232-L254), [executed suites](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220986621))

## B-344-1 — subscription-list failure silently removes plan management

`src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx:92–99,150` catches every list failure without a notice, retry, support path or unavailable state; with the initially empty array, the whole panel returns null. ([Silent failure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e7fcc5d2504e8c3948494ee847e16ff4937b78c3/src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx#L92-L99), [empty render](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e7fcc5d2504e8c3948494ee847e16ff4937b78c3/src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx#L150)) The newly changed Membership fineprint nevertheless promises that renewing plans can be canceled “from your plan here.” ([Cancellation promise](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e7fcc5d2504e8c3948494ee847e16ff4937b78c3/src/screens/client/ClientPackagesScreen.tsx#L518-L521))

Counterexample: both an initial 503 and the bare 404 from today's missing `/v1/checkout/subscriptions` route produce no visible recovery whatsoever; the real-panel probes fail with `Received: null`. ([Production controller at the operator-pinned deployed commit](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/643817b3586e27ad95cc3c519733fc14d0aaafde/src/checkout/checkout.controller.ts), [executed 404/503 probes](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220986621)) This is not a truthful old-backend fallback, and can remove the only newly provided cancel/resume controls during a transient failure. ([Panel implementation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e7fcc5d2504e8c3948494ee847e16ff4937b78c3/src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx#L92-L99))

**Minimal fix rule:** distinguish proven empty from unreadable/unavailable; render specific list-error/unavailable copy with a working Retry and support/coach action, keep any cached plan explicitly stale, and avoid promising in-app cancellation when that capability is absent. Verify both 404 and 503 through the real parent screen without introducing a one-time-only recurring fallback. ([Affected panel and parent](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/344/files))

## B-344-2 — cancellation consent promises continued access when dunning ends access now

`src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx:38–44,133–139` uses the same “stays active until … the period you paid for” confirmation for every cancellable plan, including `past_due`. The paired billing route instead voids unpaid invoices and ends access immediately for unpaid dunning, preserving the paid period only if Stripe proves it was paid meanwhile. ([Unconditional dialog](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e7fcc5d2504e8c3948494ee847e16ff4937b78c3/src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx#L38-L44), [dialog caller](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e7fcc5d2504e8c3948494ee847e16ff4937b78c3/src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx#L133-L139), [backend cancellation branches](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/bb992fedf0095446f916f3261742bd262c3d94da/src/checkout/client-billing.service.ts#L1432-L1468), [immediate-access-end result](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/bb992fedf0095446f916f3261742bd262c3d94da/src/checkout/client-billing.service.ts#L1846-L1855))

Counterexample: mount a cancellable past-due plan and tap End my plan; the real alert says “Your plan stays active until the end of the period you paid for,” with no immediate-access warning, and the consent probe fails on that exact text. ([Executed dunning-consent probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220986621))

**Minimal fix rule:** give state-specific/conditional cancellation consent covering immediate dunning cancellation and the paid-meanwhile race; only state the actual access end after the authoritative outcome. Keep the working voluntary paid-period cancellation flow and add both paths as tests. ([Current dialog](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e7fcc5d2504e8c3948494ee847e16ff4937b78c3/src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx#L133-L146))

## B-344-3 — successful plan changes can leave or restore false financial state

`src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx:92–99,105–128` discards the authoritative resume response, silently swallows its following list failure, and lets any overlapping older list read publish over a newer action/reload. ([Read/action boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e7fcc5d2504e8c3948494ee847e16ff4937b78c3/src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx#L92-L128))

Two real-panel counterexamples fail: (1) Keep my plan returns a confirmed renewing plan, then GET fails; the app still says “Ends on November 2, 2026. Nothing more is charged” although renewal resumed; (2) hold a pre-cancel reload, complete cancellation and its fresh GET, then release the old GET; the ending/Keep card reverts to Next charge/End my plan. ([Executed recovery and ordering probes](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220986621))

**Minimal fix rule:** consume the canonical returned plan where available, invalidate older read/action generations, and make a failed required refresh explicit instead of releasing the UI back to an unqualified stale financial claim. Test resume-success→reload-error and old-read→cancel→new-read→old-read for both account/lifetime-safe state and truthful copy. ([Affected action implementation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e7fcc5d2504e8c3948494ee847e16ff4937b78c3/src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx#L105-L128))

## B-344-4 — action errors request support without a working support path

`src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx:182–190` renders only `notice.message` and its reference, ignoring `notice.support`; the shared mapper can therefore instruct “email support” without an address, action, or mail-client fallback. ([Notice renderer](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e7fcc5d2504e8c3948494ee847e16ff4937b78c3/src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx#L182-L190), [notice contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e7fcc5d2504e8c3948494ee847e16ff4937b78c3/src/lib/packagePayment.ts#L617-L639))

Counterexample: Keep my plan gets a support-bearing failure; the real mapper's text/reference display, but the accessible Email support button is absent (`Received: null`), and only the same Keep my plan action remains. ([Executed support-path probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220986621))

**Minimal fix rule:** honor the support flag with the existing shared `useSupportEmail`/`SupportEmailFallback` pattern, retaining the short reference and providing a usable address/copy fallback if mail cannot open; pin both opening and fallback paths. ([Existing working purchase support implementation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e7fcc5d2504e8c3948494ee847e16ff4937b78c3/src/components/purchase/PurchaseFeedback.tsx#L198-L228))

## Optional Cs — freeze applies

- **C-344-1, carried C-334-2 — final native card-update composition:** `src/screens/client/ClientPackagesScreen.tsx:257–272` still has the inherited hosted-portal handler; when composing with the dunning stack, retain its native Update card screen and delta-check the final tree. No new blocker is assigned here to another piece's implementation. ([Prior disposition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5972086092), [current handler](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e7fcc5d2504e8c3948494ee847e16ff4937b78c3/src/screens/client/ClientPackagesScreen.tsx#L257-L272))
- **C-344-3 — post-unmount continuation:** `src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx:117–125` launches a new list request after a held action resolves following unmount; the probe expects one GET and receives two. Add an account/action-lifetime fence after awaits and in deferred alert callbacks; no cross-account rendering or unauthorized successful write is demonstrated, and the committed-identity gate unmounts prior-account navigators. ([Executed lifecycle probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220986621), [continuation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e7fcc5d2504e8c3948494ee847e16ff4937b78c3/src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx#L117-L125), [identity gate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/e7fcc5d2504e8c3948494ee847e16ff4937b78c3/src/services/PersistedQueryCacheGate.tsx#L152-L161))

## Exact evidence and landing gates

Independent test-only branch from this PR head: nine real-panel probes/controls plus all four P3 candidate suites; **7 failed / 63 passed, 70 total**, comprising six B assertions, one optional C assertion, two passing new controls, and **all 61 candidate tests passing**. ([CI lane, source `ca32060a7257ccbacea75ef4591cbe6f92846a3f`](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220986621)) Synthetic transport/native-provider and test-environment boundaries are mocked; this is not live Stripe/device acceptance, and no heavy local work or candidate-source write ran. ([Executed test-only lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37220986621))

Size is **2,086 changed lines (694 runtime / 1,392 tests)**, below the hard limit and inside the operator's KEEP assessment band; stacked Typecheck/lint/test is successful, while main-only CodeQL contexts remain a final composed/main-head gate rather than evidence already obtained here. Land #342→#343→#344 as one only after the paired backend/deploy and exact composed-tree checks; this verdict does not approve the other pieces or authorize merge/deploy. ([Operator size/landing assessment](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/344#issuecomment-5975774231), [candidate CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37219688466), [current restack](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/344#issuecomment-5982498620))

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-mobile#344 @ e7fcc5d2504e8c3948494ee847e16ff4937b78c3 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

A/B/C = 0/2/7

Lens: AUD-OPUS-SH3-118 (agent 118). T4: money copy, payment flow, plan cancel. This is against B-SHEET-118 FIX ROUND 1 (restack) ([5982498620](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/344#issuecomment-5982498620)). IDs start at 5 so they do not collide with the other lens's IDs on this PR.

### Prior findings and evidence reuse (G09)
- No lens verdict exists on #344. The original is #334: the last Opus APPROVE is at `0629d506` ([5964822138](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5964822138), C-334-2 only). Opus never audited FIX ROUND 3 or 4 there.
- The 4 source files of this piece (`YourPlansPanel.tsx`, `ClientPackagesScreen.tsx`, `PackageCheckoutScreen.tsx`, `PackageDetailSurface.tsx`) and 2 tests are byte-identical to #334 `0629d506`.
- **Reused:** only the layout and rendering of those 4 files.
- **Audited in full:**
  - the hook and copy contracts these files now call (#342/#343 changed them heavily since `0629d506`);
  - the backend contracts they call: recurring `67905b43` and dunning D3/D4 `bb992fed`/`06307883`;
  - `PackageSelectionSheet.recur3.test.tsx` (never approved by Opus);
  - the subscription-test delta;
  - the restack.
- **Restack:** `d9e7da55` is the automatic merge. Its tree `8ab7ded5` equals `git merge-tree f629e0f9 fd739d58`, so nothing was resolved by hand, and no S3 source changed.
- **Fixture commit `e7fcc5d2`:** accepted. It is test-only. Today + 7 matches what the hook computes (`trialFirstChargeDate`, local calendar). The moved-date path stays covered by #343 `usePackagePurchase.boundary.test.tsx:183-198`. A small flake window is noted as C-344-10.
- **C-334-2** (#322 / lockout L1-L3 native Update card) is still open as a composition gate.

### B-344-5: past-due plans in Your plans. "End my plan" promises access it does not keep, the outcome is never shown, and the card-update instruction leads nowhere
`src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx:39-42, 55-56, 95, 105-151`

1. **False promise before ending the plan.**
   - The backend offers End my plan on a past-due plan: `can_cancel = live && !cancel_at_period_end`, and `live` includes `past_due` (recurring `subscription-plan.ts:352,393` @ `67905b43`).
   - D3/D4 `cancelPlan` sends a delinquent plan to `runDunningCancel` (`client-billing.service.ts:1467,1539` @ `bb992fed`; route `client-billing.controller.ts:207` @ `06307883`). That is owner ruling 2A: void the open invoice and end access now.
   - The confirmation still says "Your plan stays active until November 2, 2026, and nothing more is charged after that." Because the failed renewal already moved the period end forward, that date is a period the client has not paid for.
2. **The outcome is never shown.**
   - `cancelClientPlan` discards the `CancelPlanResult` (`packagePayment.ts:387-389`: `outcome`, `access_ends_at`, `voided_amount_cents`).
   - The reload then filters out the ended plan (`:95`), so the panel goes blank with no word about what happened.
3. **The past-due line points to something that does not exist.**
   - It says "Update your card from the payment notice in the app". On this tree that notice never renders: `getPaymentStatus` always returns `dunning: null` (`clientPaymentsApi.ts:603`), and the native Update card lives in the lockout stack #352-#354.

**Probe:** [run 37221785062](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37221785062) (`audit/AUD-OPUS-SH3-118/344-plans`, real panel and copy). Both B-344-5 cases fail:
- the past_due confirmation contains "stays active until";
- after `outcome: 'ended'`, the rendered panel is empty.

The controls pass: active-plan copy, the past-due line, PLAN_ALREADY_ENDED.

**Fix rule:**
- When `state === 'past_due'`, the confirmation says access ends today and the unpaid charge is canceled, so nothing more is charged (2A). Otherwise keep the period-end copy.
- After the cancel, show the backend outcome: `scheduled` gives "Ends on <access_ends_at>"; `ended` gives "This plan has ended. The unpaid <amount> was canceled and is not collected."; `already_ended` gets its own line.
- The past-due line names an action that exists on the landed tree. Either wire the native Update card here (if #352-#354 lands first) or use a truthful fallback (End my plan, or message the coach).

**Verify:** the probe's two B-344-5 cases turn green, and the controls stay green.

### B-344-6: a failed plan action uses purchase copy and has no support path
`YourPlansPanel.tsx:121-125, 182-191`, using `describeBackendFailure(err, "plan_action", null)`

The panel renders only `message` and `reference`. It ignores `support`, `openPlan` and `checkAgain`, so there is no Email support action. The copy is the payment copy:
- **Offline:** "This phone is offline, so the payment did not start and nothing was charged … then start again." There was no payment, and the copy never says the plan was not changed.
- **401 and 429:** "Sign in again, then choose your plan" and "too many payment attempts".
- **Unknown errors** (D3 `STRIPE_REQUEST_FAILED`): "email support and quote reference req-7f3a." The panel then appends " Reference req-7f3a." a second time, and offers no Email support button and no address.
- **Bare 404 on cancel:** this is the real state when recurring #678-#680 is deployed without D4 (the recurring tree has no cancel route, and the land rule in the PR body names only the recurring chain). The copy says "its result is not confirmed yet". In fact nothing ran (`packagePayment.ts:796-807` maps a bare 404 only for `subscription_intent`).

**Probe:** same run. Three cases fail: no Email support, "payment did not start", "not confirmed yet". The control showing today's production fallback (the list 404s and the panel stays hidden) passes.

**Fix rule:**
- Give plan actions their own copy: "your plan was not changed" plus the action to repeat ("choose End my plan again"). A bare 404 on cancel or resume says ending or keeping a plan is not available in the app yet and the plan is unchanged, then "message your coach".
- Render support notices the way `PurchaseFeedback.tsx:198-231` does: Email support plus `SupportEmailFallback`, with the reference shown once.

**Verify:** the probe's three B-344-6 cases turn green.

### C (optional; under the freeze these go to the operator)
- **C-344-5:** `PackageCheckoutScreen.tsx:156`. Share-link terms come from the public storefront payload. That payload always serves `trial_days: null` (`storefront.service.ts:187`) and turns a combo into `one_time` at the one-time price (`:208-217`).
  - A trial package shared by link shows charge-today terms, and the review then says "The terms of this plan changed since it was shown", which is false.
  - A combo loops on RECURRING_REQUIRES_SUBSCRIPTION with the "Your coach changed how this plan is billed" copy. There is no in-app combo creation, so this is a C.
  - Fix: read the authoritative package for the signed-in client, or have the storefront return trial and recurring fields.
- **C-344-6:** `PackageDetailSurface.tsx:176`. The buyer pay button's `accessibilityLabel` stays "Continue to payment" while the visible label is the terms CTA (for example "Start free trial"). Fix: use `payLabel`.
- **C-344-7:** `YourPlansPanel.tsx:92-99`. Every load failure hides the panel. Fix: hide only on a bare 404; otherwise show a line telling the client to pull down to refresh. Note that the fine print at `ClientPackagesScreen.tsx:519-521` promises cancel "from your plan here".
- **C-344-8:** `YourPlansPanel.tsx:205-219`. Keep my plan turns renewal back on without stating the amount or the next charge date. Fix: show "renews at <amount> on <date>" with the action.
- **C-344-9 (outside this diff, on touched screens):** `ClientPackagesScreen.tsx:311-313` says "Your card never touches our servers" (first person). `PackageDetailSurface.tsx:196` says "Card details never touch this app", which is inaccurate with the in-app PaymentSheet. Fix: "Card details go straight to Stripe and never reach The Growth Project's servers."
- **C-344-10:** `PackageSelectionSheet.recur3.test.tsx:94`. `TRIAL_PLAN` computes today + 7 at module load, so a run that crosses local midnight reviews the date. Fix: compute it inside the test or freeze time.
- **C-344-11:** `PackageCheckoutScreen.tsx:161`. `share_token` is sent to analytics, following the existing `package_checkout_opened` pattern. Fix: send the package id and sale kind only.

### Checks and size
- Typecheck, lint, test pass at this head ([run 37219688466](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37219688466)). CodeQL runs only when the stack is on main.
- Independent replay of this piece's 4 suites at this head: 61 of 61 pass ([run 37221553555](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37221553555), together with the probe).
- Size: +1,839 / -247 = 2,086 lines, which is in the 1,500-3,000 band.
